Apartment in Ohrid Ideal For A Family

Ohrid
Price from:

3,000.00 ден

Included in price:

  • Price for renting the apartment per night: €50
  • Reservations for a minimum of three nights
  • The price is not fixed and varies depending on the season and number of nights
  • The price may be higher during holidays and peak season
  • Heating/Cooling
  • TV/Wi-Fi

Not included in price:

  • Transportation to the accommodation
  • Food

Apartment in Ohrid for one family. You can book the accommodation in Ohrid by sending a reservation request. After sending the request, you will receive a response via email, SMS, and Viber with the total price. It is recommended to make reservations in writing, as it is the safest option for both you and the hosts.

Макс. Капацитет : 4
Кревети : 2
Check In : 14:00
Check Out : 11:00
Климатизирано
Паркинг
Wi-Fi

Location
The apartment is located on Turistička Boulevard, near the Sky Corner Hotel.

Accommodation & Capacity
The apartment has 2 rooms with 2 double beds and a maximum capacity of 4 guests. A minimum stay of 2 nights is required.

It is located on the 5th floor with no elevator.

Layout
The apartment includes a kitchen, bathroom, balcony, living room, and a gallery with a separate bedroom.

Amenities
The apartment is equipped with:

  • Refrigerator
  • Washing machine
  • Bed linen and towels
  • Hygiene products
  • Hair dryer
  • Iron
  • Mini stove

The kitchen is fully equipped.

Internet & Parking

  • Wi-Fi available
  • Free street parking available

Location & Surroundings
The apartment is in a central urban area, close to the market, restaurants, shops, and supermarkets. The neighborhood is quiet and safe.

Check-in / Check-out
Check-in: 14:00 (flexible if no previous guests)
Check-out: 11:00 (flexible if no next guests)

Access
The key is collected from the hosts.

Additional Information

  • Bicycle storage available
  • Pets are not allowed
  • Total number of beds: 2

Heating / Cooling

  • Inverter air conditioning 

LOCATION

*The exact location will be provided after making a reservation. We share the location after reservation confirmation to avoid unbooked guests arriving and disturbing those currently staying.
